about.title: About ohMyStock
about.intro: ohMyStock is an experimental AI trading agent for the Taiwan stock market — screening, entry, exit, and review are all driven by LLMs.
about.demo_note: This public page is a live cartoon of what the backend LLM agents are doing. All stock symbols are replaced with fictional tokens (STK-A, STK-B, ...) and all price / position / P&L fields are removed from the SSE stream.
about.not_advice: Nothing on this site constitutes investment advice. Any decision you make based on it is your own responsibility.
